law.catch_line: Exemption from registration under other acts
law.text:
Any membership camping operator registered with the Commissioner under this chapter shall not be required to register or comply with the terms and requirements of the following:
The Virginia Condominium Act (§ 55.1-1900 et seq.).
The Virginia Real Estate Time-Share Act (§ 55.1-2200 et seq.).
The Virginia Securities Act (§ 13.1-501 et seq.).
